onnxruntime-web 1.18.0 (wasm, SIMD, one thread)
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/onnxruntime-web@1.18.0/dist/ort.wasm.min.js
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/onnxruntime-web@1.18.0/dist/ort-wasm-simd.wasm

What this is
The browser build of ONNX Runtime used only to run the U2-Netp subject model.
Caviot Studio loads these files when Find subject is clicked, and not on a phone
in the light memory tier. They are not precached.
